instruction: The VLC traffic cone icon in the interface is distracting me. How do I disable the background cone display in VLC's Qt interface to have a cleaner look when no video is playing?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to disable VLC's background cone display (qt-bgcone=0). The evaluator checks the vlcrc config file for the 'qt-bgcone' setting and verifies it is set to 0 (disabled). Using existing metric function check_qt_bgcone from vlc.py. Default value is 1 (enabled).
metadata.verification: Reuses existing check_qt_bgcone metric which checks the qt-bgcone setting in VLC config file (default is 1, task requires setting to 0)
